title: Brussels Sprout Salad With Pomegranate and Pistachios
description: An autumn-inspired salad with shaved brussels sprouts, bulgur, mint, pomegranate seeds, and pistachios tossed in a tangy lemon-sumac dressing.

steps.instruction: In a medium saucepan, combine the bulgur and water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Drain the bulgur through a fine-mesh strainer to remove excess water.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, sumac, honey, salt, and black pepper until emulsified.
Add the sliced brussels sprouts and toss well to coat in the dressing.
Add the cooked bulgur, scallions, mint, and pomegranate seeds, then toss to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Stir in the chopped pistachios just before serving.
